Jet.DriverOperationFailed

`{problem}`

What

`{problem}`

Why

Jet could not complete the named file, tool, or operating-system operation.

Fix

Correct the named problem, then run the command again.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.DriverOperationFailed: Tests/UI/inspect_live_attach_refused_other_user_e2105.stderr.

Error: Jet.DriverOperationFailed: Process 1 belongs to another user
 Why: Jet could not complete the named file, tool, or operating-system operation
 Fix: Run the program yourself with `jet run --observe`, then `jet inspect live --attach` its process id
